findings.explanation: You must accept scope changes without extra pay as long as they fit within the overall project budget, forcing you to absorb extra work without additional compensation up to that limit.
findings.suggested_change: Any changes to scope requested by the Client shall be documented in a written change request and billed at the Contractor's standard hourly rates or as mutually agreed in writing.

findings.quoted_text: The parties intend to allow 15 rounds of ordinary revisions for the principal creative Deliverables. Additional revisions may require a written change order.
findings.explanation: The contract permits 15 rounds of revisions, which is an excessively high allowance that can lead to significant uncompensated work.
findings.suggested_change: The parties agree to include up to three rounds of revisions for the deliverables, with any further revisions subject to additional fees.

findings.explanation: Payment terms of Net 60 require you to wait up to 60 days to be paid after invoicing, creating potential cash flow strain for your business.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning scope changes, the current terms require absorbing extra work without additional compensation, so I propose that any changes to scope be documented in a written change request and billed at standard hourly rates or as mutually agreed in writing. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning revision rounds, the allowance of fifteen rounds is excessively high and can lead to uncompensated work, so I propose that we include up to three rounds of revisions for the deliverables, with any further revisions subject to additional fees. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning payment terms, waiting up to sixty days creates cash flow strain, so I propose that invoices are payable Net 30. Thank you for your flexibility, and I look forward to working together.
